easyPrerequisites:
You control a land that can tap to produce {W}.
Incubation Druid and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}{W}
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Aphetto Alchemist and Incubation Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aphetto Alchemist ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
